about.metaDescription: Learn about RENN Products LLP, our mission, core story, values, and commitment to gentle softness and reliable hygiene.
about.heroTitle: Softness that cares. Cleanliness that protects.
about.heroText: Experience the perfect balance of luxurious softness and reliable hygiene. Our premium tissues, toilet rolls, and hygiene essentials are thoughtfully crafted to be gentle on your skin while keeping your home and family protected every day.
about.directionHeading: It began with a simple realization: Hygiene should never come at the cost of comfort.
about.directionParagraph1: In a world full of harsh, rough, or overly chemical-laden products, we saw the need for tissues and hygiene essentials that truly care for the people who use them every day. So, we set out to create a better way.
about.directionParagraph2: Today, every product we make reflects our belief that the little things — a soft tissue when you need it most, a reliable roll that never tears, a fresh wipe that feels caring — can make a meaningful difference in daily life. We exist because we believe every touch should feel cared for.
about.missionHeading: To elevate everyday hygiene with genuine softness, reliable protection, and thoughtful care.
about.missionText1: We believe true hygiene goes beyond cleanliness — it should feel comforting, be kind to sensitive skin, and bring peace of mind to every home.
about.missionText2: That’s why we create premium tissues, toilet rolls, wet wipes, and hygiene essentials that deliver the perfect balance of luxurious comfort and uncompromising cleanliness.
about.promiseText: At RENN, we believe hygiene should never compromise comfort. Our commitment is simple: Prioritize your family's comfort, use high-quality skin-friendly materials, maintain strict hygiene standards, and continuously innovate sustainably.
about.focusHeading: We don't just make tissues — we create them with purpose.
about.marketsHeading: Delivering soft, dependable hygiene across industries.

products.title: Toilet Paper / Bathroom Tissue
products.text: Experience ultimate comfort with our 3-ply toilet paper, crafted from sustainable virgin and recycled pulp. Extra soft yet strong, it dissolves quickly to prevent clogs while delivering a gentle, thorough clean for your family.

products.title: Lotion Facial Tissues
products.text: Indulge in soothing softness with lotion-infused facial tissues. Designed to be gentle on delicate skin, these multi-ply tissues trap moisture effectively without irritation. Ideal for allergies, colds, makeup removal, or daily touch-ups.

products.title: Heavy-Duty Kitchen Paper Towels
products.text: Super absorbent and tough – our kitchen towels handle big messes with ease. Made with recycled fibers for an eco-conscious choice, they are perfect for drying hands, cleaning countertops, and wiping spills without leaving lint behind.

products.title: Napkins & Custom Logo Printed Napkins
products.text: Embossed paper napkins for meals, parties, or wiping hands and mouth. Available in cocktail, dinner, and custom sizes with custom logo printing to enhance tabletop presentation for restaurants, cafes, and events.

products.title: N / Z Fold Interfolded Tissues
products.text: Interfolded single-sheet dispenser tissues designed for controlled, hygienic single-sheet dispensing in commercial washrooms, offices, clinics, and restaurants. Reduces product waste and cross-contamination.

products.title: Kitchen Aluminium Foil
products.text: Food-safe aluminium foil rolls for wrapping, takeaway packing, baking, storage, catering, and everyday commercial kitchens. Provides an airtight heat and moisture barrier to lock in food freshness.
